name: Ministral 3 8B (multimodal)
notes: PARAMS: 8.92B is the safetensors count including the vision tower; HF metadata shows 7.4B of the total stored as F8_E4M3 (fp8) and 1.5B as BF16, so this checkpoint is natively partly-fp8. That dtype split matters for serving: it is not a post-hoc quantization of an fp16 model. KV: 34 * 8 * 128 * 2 * 2 bytes = 139,264 bytes/token = 136 KiB/token, at bf16. The text tower is nearly identical to Ministral 8B (34 layers vs 36, same width) so KV per token barely moved, but context went from 32k to 262144, an 8x increase in worst-case KV. MULTIMODAL: vision_config is a 24-layer 1024-hidden pixtral-style encoder, so this is a VLM despite the small parameter count. ViT cost lands in prefill. No sliding window.
